summary: This document specifies how to augment the Routing Policy Specification Language inetnum: class to point to geofeed data, which are CSV files stating where IP address ranges are located. It also describes an optional scheme using the Routing PKI to authenticate those files. It was replaced by RFC 9632.

eli5.summary: Network owners can publish a file saying which place each of their addresses is in. This document explains how to find that file and check it is genuine. It was replaced by RFC 9632.

questions: how to publish ip geolocation data rpsl
